item.title: Nigeria Rolls Out 1% Tax on Informal Businesses Under New Fiscal Framework
item.description: Nigeria introduced a 1% flat tax on the turnover of informal-sector businesses under a new presumptive tax framework. item.title: African Airlines Passenger Traffic Rises 11.7% in January 2026
